# On Rivers

The Danube is a river that runs through ten countries. Dr. Smith measured it in 1965.
It carries 2,850 km of water, e.g. past Vienna.

## Tributaries

- The Inn, the fastest of them, joins at Passau.
- A second tributary is called the Morava.

Mr. J. R. Hartley wrote "the river remembers everything" on 3 March 2001. Was he right? Perhaps... perhaps not.
